     11  ## Setup
     12  
     13  Install the service and point it at a log directory.
     14  
     15  ### Requirements
     16  
     17  - Python 3.10 or newer
     18  - A writable log directory
     19

$ reveal guide.md 'Order Service Guide'
guide.md:6-57 | Order Service Guide

      6  # Order Service Guide
      7  
      8  The order service validates, logs and batches orders.
      9  This intro sits above the first second-level heading.
     10  
     11  ## Setup
     12  
     13  Install the service and point it at a log directory.
     14  
     15  ### Requirements
     16  
     17  - Python 3.10 or newer
     18  - A writable log directory
     19  
     20  ### Configuration
     21  
     22  Set `ORDER_LOG` to the log path.
     23  
     24  ```bash
     25  # not a heading: a shell comment inside a fence
     26  export ORDER_LOG=/var/log/orders.log
     27  ```
     28  
     29  ## Usage
     30  
     31  Call `process_order(order)` for each order.
     32  
     33  ### Batching
     34  
     35  `Batch.run(items)` totals a list and caches each item.
     36  
     37  ## Release 1.1
     38  
     39  ### Fixed
     40  
     41  - Empty orders no longer raise.
     42  
     43  ## Release 1.0
     44  
     45  ### Fixed
     46  
     47  - First release.
     48  
     49  ## See [the API](api.md) &amp; notes ##
     50  
     51  Cross-references live here.
     52  
     53  ## Known gaps
     54  
     55  ## 2026
     56  
     57  Plans for the year.
[exit 0]
